sourcedFrom: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 (Copyright © 2018 Smith & Wesson Corp.)
cleanIntro: The Bodyguard 380 field strips to five pieces — frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring and magazine — and the one step that is unlike any other M&P is that the takedown lever comes right out of the frame rather than staying captive. Deep Clean is the magazine, which the manual documents separately.

steps.title: Work out which Bodyguard 380 you have before you touch anything
steps.action: Look at your pistol and settle two questions: does it have a manual thumb safety lever on the left side of the frame, and does it have an integrated Crimson Trace laser with an activation button on both sides of the frame. Smith & Wesson builds this model in all four combinations and the steps below change depending on the answer.
steps.prose: The thumb safety is the one that bites during takedown — on a safety-equipped gun the lever has to go down to the FIRE position before the slide will move at all, and a person who does not know their gun has one will decide the slide is jammed. The laser matters differently: it has its own appendix, its own maintenance and its own warranty, and none of that is in the main body of the manual.
steps.quote: YOU MUST DETERMINE WHICH FEATURES ARE PRESENT ON YOUR M&P® BODYGUARD®380 PISTOL AND HOW THOSE FEATURES OPERATE. VARIOUS MODELS OF THE M&P® BODYGUARD® PISTOLS ARE FITTED WITH DISTINCT FEATURES WHICH MAY INCLUDE; A MANUAL THUMB SAFETY AND AN INTEGRATED
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Model and Features Identification, WARNING, p.12
steps.warn: You must determine which features are present on your M&P BODYGUARD 380 pistol and how those features operate.

steps.title: Magazine out, safety to FIRE, slide back and locked
steps.action: Point the pistol in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger, press the magazine release and take the magazine out. If your pistol has the thumb safety, put the lever down into the FIRE position so the slide can move, then grasp the serrated sides of the slide from the rear and draw it briskly fully rearward to throw out anything in the chamber. Lock it open by holding it fully back and pressing up on the slide stop.
steps.prose: Magazine first, always — this pistol will fire with the magazine out if a round is chambered. The draw has to be brisk and complete: a slow pull on this small pistol's short slide will pluck a round loose and drop it back into the port rather than clearing it, and the manual specifically tells you not to obstruct the ejection port while doing it.
steps.quote: Lock the slide open by holding the slide fully rearward and pressing up on the slide stop (FIGURE 22).
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.22

steps.title: Look into the chamber, then down the magazine well
steps.action: With the slide locked back, look into the chamber and confirm it is empty, then look down through the magazine well and confirm nothing is in the pistol. Unload the magazine separately by pressing each cartridge forward and out.
steps.prose: Two places, two looks. The Bodyguard 380's magazine well is narrow and dark, and a round that failed to eject can lie in the frame under the feed ramp where a glance at the chamber alone will not find it. Empty the magazine before it goes back on the bench so there is no loaded item anywhere in the job.
steps.quote: Make certain that the firearm is clear of any ammunition (chamber and magazine well) (FIGURES 23 and 24).
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.22

steps.title: Nothing marked +P+, and nothing but what the barrel says
steps.action: Fire only cartridges designated by the marking on the firearm, and never ammunition marked +P+. On a pistol this small the temptation is to reach for the hottest .380 on the shelf; the marking on the box is what decides, not the advertising.
steps.prose: Smith & Wesson's objection to +P+ is that the marking names no defined pressure limit at all, so two boxes carrying it can be far apart in what they generate. The Bodyguard 380 is a light blowback-class carry pistol and pressure it was not designed for shows up as battered frame rails and a recoil spring that stops holding the slide shut.
steps.quote: "Plus-P-Plus" (+P+) ammunition must not be used in Smith & Wesson firearms. This marking on the ammunition designates that it exceeds established industry standards, but the designation does not represent defined pressure limits and therefore such ammunition may vary significantly as to the pressures generated and could be DANGEROUS.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Ammunition, p.11

steps.title: Use the magazine that came with this pistol
steps.action: Set aside any magazine that did not come with this model. A magazine from another Smith & Wesson pistol may well insert into the Bodyguard 380 and will only function properly in the model it was designed for.
steps.prose: This matters at cleaning time because magazines get mixed up on a bench full of parts, and a wrong-model magazine that seats and latches gives every appearance of being right until it fails to feed or drops free under recoil. Check yours against the pistol before it goes back in the safe.
steps.quote: While your magazine may be able to be inserted into another model pistol, it will only function properly in the specific model for which it was designed. Do not interchange magazines from one model pistol to another model pistol.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Loading, p.17

steps.title: Rotate the takedown lever down past 6 o'clock
steps.action: With the slide still locked open, rotate the takedown lever on the left side of the frame downward past the 6 o'clock position. A non-marring tool such as a plastic pen may be needed to start it.
steps.prose: The lever is small, stiff from the factory and sits flush, so fingers alone often will not turn it — that is normal on this pistol and not a fault. Use plastic or wood, not a screwdriver: the lever and the frame around it mark easily, and a metal blade that slips goes across the frame rail.
steps.quote: Rotate the takedown lever down past the 6 o'clock position (FIGURE 25).
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.23

steps.title: Take the takedown lever right out of the frame
steps.action: Keep going: grasp the lever, rotate it past the 9 o'clock position and pull it out of the frame entirely. Some wiggling is usually needed to work it free.
steps.prose: This is the step that separates the Bodyguard 380 from every other M&P pistol — on the M&P22 Compact the takedown lever is captive and must not be removed, and on the Shield family it stays in the frame too. Here the lever is a loose part that comes out in your hand, so it is also a part you can lose; put it somewhere deliberate rather than on the bench edge.
steps.quote: Remove the takedown lever from the frame by grasping it and rotating it past the 9 o'clock position and pulling it out of the frame (FIGURE 26). Some wiggling of the takedown lever may be required to get it out of the frame.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.23

steps.title: Ease the slide closed, then push it forward off the frame
steps.action: Grasp the serrated sides, draw the slide rearward until the slide stop disengages, and let it run carefully forward to its closed position. Then push the slide forward off the front of the frame with your thumb, keeping hold of the recoil spring and guide rod as they come free.
steps.prose: Do not just thumb the slide stop down and let the slide snap shut — with the takedown lever gone there is nothing holding the assembly together and the spring is loaded. The recoil spring is under pressure the whole way and will launch if you let go of it; keep a hand over the front of the slide as it leaves the frame.
steps.quote: Remove the slide from the frame by pushing it forward with your thumb while being careful to retain the recoil spring and guide rod assembly
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.23
steps.warn: The recoil spring is under pressure. Control the spring so that it does not fly out and cause injury.

steps.title: Recoil spring and barrel out of the slide
steps.action: Lift the recoil spring assembly out of the slide, then take the barrel out of the slide. You now have five pieces: frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring and magazine.
steps.prose: The barrel lifts clear once the spring is gone and needs no force — if it resists, the spring is still partly captured under the barrel lug. That is the whole strip; the internals of the frame stay where they are.
steps.quote: Remove the recoil spring from the slide (FIG. 31).
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.24

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, magazine and the loose takedown lever — that is the pistol field stripped for cleaning and lubricating, and it is as far as Smith & Wesson takes it. Deep Clean covers the magazine, which the manual documents as its own procedure.
steps.prose: The limit is stated plainly: nothing inside the frame is to be manipulated beyond what the manual instructs.
steps.quote: NEVER DISASSEMBLE YOUR HANDGUN BEYOND THE FIELD STRIPPING PROCESS OUTLINED IN THIS MANUAL. NEVER MANIPULATE ANY INTERNAL COMPONENTS BEYOND WHAT YOU ARE SPECIFICALLY INSTRUCTED TO DO IN THIS MANUAL SINCE THIS MAY AFFECT THE RELIABILITY, FUNCTIONING AND SAFETY OF YOUR HANDGUN.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.24

deepSteps.title: Empty the magazine and press the floor plate catch
deepSteps.action: Take every cartridge out of the magazine first. Then use a drift punch through the hole in the floor plate to depress the floor plate catch inside.
deepSteps.prose: The hole in the floor plate is small and the catch sits directly under it — a punch that is too large will not reach the catch and one that slips scores the tube. Keep the magazine pointed away from your face from this moment on, because the spring is compressed under that catch.
deepSteps.quote: Using a drift punch, depress floor plate catch through the hole in the floor plate (FIGURE 51).
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Magazine Disassembly, step 1, p.29
deepSteps.warn: The magazine spring is under pressure. Control the spring and follower so that they do not fly out and cause injury.

deepSteps.title: Slide the floor plate off while holding the catch down
deepSteps.action: Keep the catch pressed into the tube and slide the floor plate off. Do not let the catch up until the plate is clear.
deepSteps.prose: Your thumb has to take over from the punch as the plate moves — the instant the plate stops covering the catch, the spring is trying to push catch, spring and follower out of the bottom of the tube. Let it out under control rather than letting it happen.
deepSteps.quote: Slide floor plate off of the tube while holding floor plate catch in the tube (FIGURE 52).
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Magazine Disassembly, step 2, p.29

deepSteps.title: Catch, spring and follower out of the bottom
deepSteps.action: Ease the floor plate catch, the spring and the follower out through the bottom of the tube, and note which way round the spring sat before you put it down.
deepSteps.prose: The spring is reversible top to bottom but it is not orientation-free in use: the manual specifies keeping the uphill slant toward the front of the magazine when it goes back in, and a spring installed backwards causes nose-dive feeding rather than an obvious failure. Clean the inside of the tube and the follower now — powder residue in a .380 magazine is what makes the last round sit low.
deepSteps.quote: Remove floor plate catch, spring and follower out through bottom of tube (FIGURE 53).
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For M&P® BODYGUARD®380 with or without manual thumb safety and M&P® BODYGUARD®380 Integrated Crimson Trace® Laser with or without manual thumb safety — P/N 3000488                      REV:M&P BODYGUARD_380_080118 — Magazine Disassembly, step 3, p.29

cleaning.name: BARREL AND CHAMBER
tasks: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber with a properly fitted brass brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent
Finish by running a dry cotton cloth patch through the bore to carry out residue and solvent
Clean the feed ramp and the outside of the barrel where it rides in the slide
Check the bore is clear of obstructions before the pistol goes back together

cleaning.name: SLIDE AND FRAME
tasks: Clean the breech face, the extractor claw and the inside of the slide where the barrel sits
Clean the frame rails and the recess the takedown lever passes through
Clean the exterior of the pistol with a non-abrasive cleaning cloth
Remove all cleaning solution, oil and fingerprints from the outside surfaces

cleaning.name: MAGAZINE
tasks: Wipe the outside of the tube and the feed lips
If the magazine has been apart, clean the inside of the tube and the follower before reassembling
Check the floor plate is locked on by trying gently to slide it off

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: A single drop of firearm oil at each of the points the manual marks — no more
Excess lubricant collects powder residue and can interfere with proper functioning of the pistol
Avoid prolonged solvent immersion and prolonged ultrasonic cleaning
Never use ammoniated or other strong alkaline solvents on this pistol

reassembly: Put the barrel back into the slide, then the recoil spring and guide rod assembly, keeping the spring controlled.
Slide the slide assembly onto the frame rails from the front and bring it rearward into position.
Lock the slide open on the slide stop, then insert the takedown lever into the frame and rotate it back up into its horizontal locked position.

Reassemble the magazine follower, spring and floor plate catch into the tube in the same orientation they came out — the spring is reversible but its uphill slant goes toward the front of the magazine — then slide the floor plate on until the catch engages its hole.
Release the slide and confirm it runs fully forward into battery.
fncheck: With the pistol empty and pointed in a safe direction, cycle the slide by hand several times and confirm it runs fully into battery and that the slide stop locks it open on an empty magazine and releases cleanly. Confirm the takedown lever is rotated fully back up into its locked position — if it is not, the slide can come off the frame under recoil. If your pistol has the manual thumb safety, check that the slide will not move with the lever up in SAFE and moves freely with it down in FIRE. Then insert an empty magazine and check it seats, latches and drops free on the release.
